author: nicolas
summary: Liraasa 3.4, "Abstraction and the human condition" (ADR-0024), from the author's 3.4 patch. PROPOSED: PROPOSED: ratify tier 1 first; tier 2 may be ratified, deferred or dropped item by item. Additions only, no new roots: ruling 3.4:G149; 94 compounds, 18 listed derivations, 3 lexicalised diminutives, 1 restored form and 50 English aliases, each entry noted with its tier. No 3.3 word, spelling or ruling changes.

rulings.ruling: For a compound X whose adjective is available under 3.3:G148, the bare compound names the quality and X-san describes what has it: tibilekta complexity, tibilektasan complex; lordidoza strictness, lordidozasan strict. A person defined by a quality is li + the adjective (1.2:G29): li corvinasan, the coward. No -ness or -ity suffix is needed or created.
examples: Li lordidozasan lemudonuyo po ne merama li linu.
The strict teacher did not forgive the child.
